meta.title: Conversation wrap-up
meta.description: Cleans up after a chat. A “Wrap up” button beside the title lists every file this conversation produced in the workspace, grouped into deliverables / drafts / scripts / temp files with a one-line reason for each, and moves the ticked ones to the recycle bin. Queue the session itself and it is removed once idle for 30 minutes. Workspace only; never DSH data or system files.
